Validation looks up active key/ops, accepts expiry at or after now and compares string values; it does not add an OTP-type predicate in the inspected lookup.
Validation calls process.nextSuccess/error before updating limit/deactivation, does not await persistence and only logs update failure; concurrent verification can pass twice or lose decrements.
No delivery, resend cooldown, account rate/lockout or challenge audit orchestration is present in the OTP service call path.
correctnessAndCoverageLimitations: OTP_ATOMICITY_GAP: intended singleUseToken/decrement flags do not provide atomic consume/attempt enforcement or guaranteed persisted lockout.
REQUIRED_INTEGRATION_GAP: delivery, cooldown/rate limits, subject/session/purpose policy and safe audit must be implemented/qualified by consuming owners.
No OTP generation/validation, raw code, security test or live acceptance was performed.
remediation: Added exact generation/expiry/validation/limit behavior and a later-layer policy example.
Replaced unsupported single-use/throttle/audit claims with explicit integration/atomicity handoff.
Added redacted evidence and uncertain-update recovery boundaries without raw secrets.

items.requestedAction: Document SMTP/SMS providers, templates, retry, failed delivery evidence, and extension rules.
items.rationale: Compared communication provider, retry and failure explanations with canonical DMS source-eligibility dispatch. A contributed owner must match source module, OPERATIONAL authority, internal authenticated route and bounded one-attempt transport; malformed or unconfirmed replies refuse send. Frozen intent, original source identity, retry/UNCERTAIN reconciliation and provider restrictions remain intact. The existing guide does not claim live carrier support, automatic retry workers or business-state authority from a notification receipt.
sourceFindings: Communication runtime owns persisted attempt/lease/outcome projection. A new resolveUncertain decision requires current expectedRevision, explicit confirmation/reason/operator and MARK_DELIVERED/AUTHORIZE_RESEND/CANCEL; exact original revision/action/reason/operator replay is read-only and never sends or appends a second decision.

Configured source eligibility is frozen into intent identity and rechecked read-only before claim and before transport using bound tenant/source/recipient evidence. Template resources now also support TELEGRAM/IN_APP without changing the guide's EMAIL/SMS behavior.
Retry uses persisted state and refuses uncertain or exhausted sends; delivery failure does not reset an owning domain operation.
Template service validates owner-contained resources, declared typed variables, locale fallback, bounded content and safe HTML/URL rendering.
SMTP has controlled Nodemailer transport plus injected sandbox mode; SMS uses injected transport with bounded UTF-8 text and rejects HTML, not an implemented live carrier.
correctnessAndCoverageLimitations: The SMS maximumContentBytes prose has a malformed range/list break, leaving its upper bound unclear; repair that small presentation defect against the provider's 65536-byte configuration ceiling. This does not negate the requested implemented-mode/retry/security explanation.

The guide is not an exhaustive state/replay protocol: runtime intent expiry is CANCELLED while the table groups expiry with suppression prevention; exact lost-ack replay and source eligibility are detailed in owner contracts and focused tests.
No emails/SMS were sent and no provider credentials, endpoint behavior, deliverability or signed-in operator flow was accepted in this review.

sourceFindings: Revalidated 2026-10-20: six Contact and twenty-one Core schemas change only router configuration to enabled:false. Fields, states and indexes remain identical. The guide already requires dedicated engagementApi/owner commands and rejects raw-CRUD activation.
Submit creates the Contact record then a separate handoff; initial adapter dispatch may precede persistence. No domain/process atomicity or external exactly-once promise follows.
Public acknowledgement exposes referenceCode/duplicate/verificationRequired, not internal Contact/handoff contents.
Recoverable work is PENDING/due RETRY_PENDING/expired-lease IN_PROGRESS; repository claims/completions require matching revisions and leases.
Retry permits FAILED/DEAD_LETTER/RETRY_PENDING, does not reset attempts, and can return CONFLICT. Reconcile requires externalReference and terminal adapter lookup before RECONCILED.
Activity/correspondence/attempt/resolution schemas are not evidence every transition writes every audit/notification record; Process/Communication retain their lifecycles.
correctnessAndCoverageLimitations: Form version schema and ACTIVE lookup do not implement a full immutable form authoring/verification workflow.
Notification delivery, scheduler operation, provider lookup and public/tenant privacy enforcement need independently qualified owner acceptance.

The timer uses trigger.expression/jobDetail and runtime/node admission; local _running prevents overlapping wrapper work, not distributed exactly-once execution.

sourceFindings: isDevelopmentRelease identifies version0.0.0 only; installed nondevelopment same-version checksum drift rejects, while downgrade requires explicit allowDowngrade and is not rollback.
planForwardRelease requires newer semantic version/source sequence and immutable prior payload, retains historical roots/section identity and rejects frozen drift.

Catalogue/preflight/execute selection uses exact releaseCode and expectedReleases version; expectedReleases is not a digest signature. CURRENT is skipped and RUNNING cannot be taken over merely by timeout.
Failed/partial outcomes require secured import-run/installation reconciliation and owner idempotency; a retry is not guaranteed row-level resume.
Publication rollback delegates to the domain provider; it does not restore deployed overrides/configuration, imported/migrated records or external side effects.
